content.value: Draw the ladder diagram and functional block diagram to represent the followings: (i) (A.B + C).D.E.F = Q
(ii) A signal lamp is required to be switched on if a pump is running and the pressure is satisfactory, or if the lamp test switch is closed.
(iii) Consider a system where there has to be no output when any one of four sensors gives an output; otherwise, there is to be an output.
